summary: S7c complete: clippy clean, all 297 tests pass, and wasm passes for 50 crates.
body:
Files changed across S7c:

- `crates/interchange/src/scene/export.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/export/tests.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import/properties.rs`
- `crates/interchange/src/scene/import/tests.rs`
- `crates/interchange/tests/scene_roundtrip.rs`

This continuation changed only the approved group-clock test and added the attribution comment above `interpolation`.

Public API unchanged:

```rust
pub fn import_with(bytes: &[u8], format: Format, opts: &ImportOptions) -> Result<(Imported, Report)>
pub fn export(project: &Project, sequence: ItemId, format: Format, opts: &ExportOptions) -> Result<(Vec<u8>, Report)>
```

Design: export converts media key times using checked Tick/rational math, including trim, speed and the exclusive reverse endpoint. Outside keys remain: XSD `keyType@time` permits signed times without layer-interval bounds. Reversed hold boundaries are baked and reported. Compatible CSS curves use FilmCraft temporal handles; other curves receive bounded frame-rate baking and an explicit report. These choices follow XSD `keyType`/`animateType@timeBase`, FilmCraft `keyframe.rs::ease`, and scene-render `sr-eval/src/curve.rs::resolve`. No new ambiguity arose in this continuation.

Borrowed semantics: named CSS control points and temporal-handle resolution from `/home/admin/src/scene-render/crates/sr-eval/src/curve.rs::resolve`. The requested grant comment is present; the integrator will record attribution.

TDD red → green:

- `filmcraft_trimmed_speed_opacity_ease`: restored key at 6s instead of 2s → passes.
- `filmcraft_opacity_ease_curve`: 26.5625% instead of 29.375% → passes.
- Prior S7c log records speed-two, reverse/outside-key, named-ease, CSS baking, Motion-handle and all-eases frame regressions failing before their fixes; all pass in the final gate.
- This continuation reproduced `scene_import_css_bezier_and_local_keys_under_group_clock` failing: 26 actual keys versus two expected. The approved replacement passes with 26 linear keys spanning media 0–2s and all 24 interior frames within 1e-6 of an independent Newton solution of the expanded CSS polynomial. CSS baking and `spatialOut` report assertions remain.

Updated existing expectations: the approved group-clock test above, and `scene_export_inexact_source_and_animation`, which now expects local zero at the in-point and two inexact timestamps instead of three.

Final unfiltered VM gate exited 0:

- Clippy, all targets, warnings denied: PASS.
- Interchange tests: **297 passed** (213 unit + 84 integration, including 25 round-trip); zero failed, ignored or filtered.
- `cargo xtask wasm`: PASS, **50 crates**.

Logs: `/tmp/roundtrip-fix1-red.log`, `/tmp/roundtrip-fix1-green.log`, `/tmp/roundtrip-fix1-gate.log`.

Task complete; no locks held. No commits, pushes, new dependencies or local builds.
